purpose: Insert the first-connection formula Gamma_X^k_ij = 1/2 g^{kl} C_X_ijl into the cleaned Gamma_A Gamma_B product operator before C11 integration.

locked_convention.C_X: C_X_ijl = nabla_i h^X_jl + nabla_j h^X_il - nabla_l h^X_ij
locked_convention.ambient_first_strain: h_X(u,v)=2<u,Xv> for symmetric ambient X on the locked linear embedding path
locked_convention.background: round L(2,1) metric; all contractions use background g until finite matrix evaluation

substituted_product_operator.from_gamma_form: P_AB(alpha)_c = -g^{ij}[Gamma_A^p_ij Gamma_B^d_pc + Gamma_A^p_ic Gamma_B^d_jp - Gamma_B^d_jc Gamma_A^p_id] alpha_d + A<->B
substituted_product_operator.C_tensor_form: P_AB(alpha)_c = -1/4 g^{ij}[g^{pq} C_A_ijq g^{de} C_B_pce + g^{pq} C_A_icq g^{de} C_B_jpe - g^{de} C_B_jce g^{pq} C_A_idq] alpha_d + A<->B
substituted_product_operator.canonical_warning: The apparent third term can merge with the second term under A/B symmetrization and dummy relabeling only after the free output c and input d slots are preserved through the basis integral.

expanded_term_table.label: D1_C
expanded_term_table.expression: -1/4 g^{ij} g^{pq} g^{de} C_A_ijq C_B_pce alpha_d + A<->B
expanded_term_table.meaning: Connection variation on the contracted derivative index of the inner T_B tensor.

expanded_term_table.label: O1_C
expanded_term_table.expression: -1/4 g^{ij} g^{pq} g^{de} C_A_icq C_B_jpe alpha_d + A<->B
expanded_term_table.meaning: Connection variation on the output one-form component c.

expanded_term_table.label: G1_C
expanded_term_table.expression: +1/4 g^{ij} g^{de} g^{pq} C_B_jce C_A_idq alpha_p + A<->B; relabel input p to d only after preserving the basis slot
expanded_term_table.meaning: Connection variation on the input one-form component inside the inner first-connection term.

C11_integrand_template.after_C_insertion: replace alpha_d or alpha_p by the corresponding component of e_s; multiply by e_r^c; integrate over L(2,1)

The product contribution is zero-order on the input one-form after preserving the free output/input slots.
A symbolic integrand template for each C11 entry is fixed.

verdict: The Gamma_A Gamma_B product contribution has advanced from exact index cleanup to a C-tensor integrand formula on the locked ambient path. This is a genuine matrix-enabling formula for the product part of C_conn2[1,1], but it is not yet an evaluated C11 matrix or determinant contribution.
